en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a large sculptural monument in a city square. The statue depicts a central seated figure, surrounded by numerous standing and interacting figures, men, women, and children. The monument is surrounded by shrubbery and there are buildings in the background. The text at the top is printed in red and identifies the monument in both Hungarian and German.
